Rashi on Taanit 8a:10:1.hebrew: ואין נוחין זה לזה כו' - והכי משמע: בשביל שצריך להגיד זה לזה ולהיות נוחין בהלכה, ואינן עושין — מקנה: מתקנאים, מתגרים באף; ומעלים אותו: ומביאים אותו עליהן. ויש גורסין: "ונוחין זה לזה בהלכה מתקנאים באף וכו'" — משיגיד עליו רעו שנוחין זה לזה, מתקנאים באף ומעלים אותו מעליהם:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:10:1.english: And they are not courteous with one another, etc. - And this is what it means: Because they ought to speak to one another and be courteous in halakha, but they do not do [so] — “mikneh”: they arouse, [that is,] they provoke anger; and “they raise it up”: and they bring it upon themselves. And some have the reading: “And they are courteous with one another in halakha, they arouse [zeal against] anger, etc.” — from [the words] “His fellow tells concerning him,” [meaning] that they are courteous with one another, they contend with anger and lift it [away] from upon themselves.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:11:1.hebrew: ארי דורס ואוכל - מיד, ואינו מתירא:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:11:1.english: A lion mauls and eats - It eats immediately, and is not afraid.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:11:2.hebrew: טורף ואוכל - שמוליך לחוריו ואוכל שם, שמפחד מן הבריות, ולכולן יש להם הנאה:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:11:2.english: Tears apart and eats - That it carries its prey to its lair and eats there, because it is afraid of people; and all of them derive pleasure.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:11:3.hebrew: ולך מה הנאה יש לך - שאתה נושך בני אדם והורגן. והוא אומר: ״מה יתרון לבעל הלשון״ — שמספר לשון הרע, אע"פ שאין לו הנאה. ולפיכך מביאו הקב"ה בדין אצל נחש, כדי שיתבייש, מפני שהשיא אדם הראשון, ומתביישין עמו מספרי לשון הרע:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:11:3.english: And as for you, what pleasure do you have - That you bite people and kill them. And he says: “What advantage is there to the master of the tongue?” — who speaks slander, even though he has no pleasure. And therefore, the Holy One, blessed be He, brings him to judgment alongside the snake, so that it be shamed, because it enticed Adam the first man, and those who speak slander are shamed along with it.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:12:1.hebrew: ולבם לא נכון עמו - עם הקב"ה:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:12:1.english: And their heart was not steadfast with Him - With the Holy One, Blessed be He.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:12:2.hebrew: ואעפ"כ - כתוב בסמוך: ״והוא רחום יכפר עון״, ושומע תפלתם; והיכי אמרת שאין תפלתם נשמעת, אא"כ משים נפשו בכפו?! כלומר: שנפשו מכוונת בכפו:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:12:2.english: And nevertheless - It is written nearby in the verse: “But He, being full of compassion, forgives iniquity,” and thus He hears their prayer. And how can you say that their prayer is not heard unless one places his soul in his palm? That is to say: that his soul is focused in his palm.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:13:1.hebrew: בצבור - תפלתם נשמעת, ואע"פ שאין לב כולם שלם, כדכתיב: ״ויפתוהו בפיהם״ — בדברים, ל' רבים:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:13:1.english: In [the case of] a community - Their prayer is heard even though the heart of all of them is not whole, as it is written: “They beguiled Him with their mouth” — [that is,] with words [alone; and this is stated in] the plural.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:13:2.hebrew: ביחיד - אינו אלא א"כ לבו מכוון:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:13:2.english: In [the case of] an individual - He is [answered] only if his heart is focused.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:14:1.hebrew: בזמן שאמת מארץ תצמח - שיש אמונה במשא ומתן, אז צדק משמים נשקף, דהיינו גשמים, שהן צדקה:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:14:1.english: When truth springs out of the earth - [Meaning] that there is honesty in business dealings; then “righteousness has looked down from heaven,” that is, rain, which is [an act of] charity.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:15:1.hebrew: מחולדה ובור - שהמיתו שני בני אדם. מצוי הוא באגדה: מעשה בבחור אחד שנתן אמונתו לריבה אחת שישאנה. אמרה: ״מי מעיד?״ והיה שם בור אחד וחולדה. אמר הבחור: ״בור וחולדה עדים בדבר״. לימים, עבר על אמונתו ונשא אחרת, והוליד שני בנים: אחד נפל לבור ומת, וא' נשכתו חולדה ומת. אמרה לו אשתו: ״מה מעשה הוא זה שבנינו מתים במיתה משונה?״ ואמר לה: ״כך וכך היה המעשה״:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:15:1.english: From the marten and the pit - That they killed two people. It is found in the Aggadah: An incident involving a young man who gave his pledge to a maiden that he would marry her. She said: “Who will bear witness?” And there were a pit and a marten there. The young man said: “The pit and the marten are witnesses to the matter.” In time, he violated his pledge and married another woman, and fathered two sons: one fell into a pit and died, and one was bitten by a marten and died. His wife said to him: “What deed is this, that our sons die an unnatural death?” And he said to her: “Such and such was the incident.”

Rashi on Taanit 8a:15:2.hebrew: המאמין בהקדוש ברוך הוא - שמשימו עד בינו לבין חבירו, על אחת כמה וכמה:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:15:2.english: One who has faith in the Holy One, Blessed be He - [That is,] one who makes Him a witness between himself and his fellow; all the more so [will He uphold it].

Rashi on Taanit 8a:16:1.english: One who makes himself righteous - That he makes proper and adorns his deeds:

Rashi on Taanit 8a:16:2.hebrew: מצדיקין עליו - מדקדקין עמו אפילו כחוט השערה, יותר משאילו מקלקל מעשיו, כדי למרק עונותיו:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:16:2.english: They exact judgment upon him - They are exacting with him even to a hairsbreadth, more than if he were corrupting his deeds, in order to cleanse his iniquities.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:16:3.hebrew: שנאמר אמת מארץ תצמח - אז צדק משמים נשקף. צדקה אין כתיב כאן, אלא צדק, דמשמע דין:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:16:3.english: As it is stated: “Truth springs out of the earth” - Then “righteousness has looked down from heaven.” “Tzedakah” charity is not written here, but rather “tzedek,” which implies judgment.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:16:4.hebrew: וכיראתך עברתך - על מי שהוא ירא אותך אתה מחזיק עברתך, כדי למרק עונותיו. ופשט המקרא: "מי יודע עוז אפך" — מי יודע עוז וכח למצוא אותו לנוס מפניך ביום אפך? "וכיראתך עברתך" — כשם שאתה יראוי ומפוחד, כך יש להתיירא ולהתפחד מעברתך:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:16:4.english: “And according to the fear of You is Your wrath” - Upon one who fears You, You hold fast Your wrath, in order to cleanse his iniquities. And the plain meaning of the verse [is]: “Who knows the power of Your anger?” — Who knows [how] to find the strength and power to flee from before You on the day of Your anger? “And according to the fear of You is Your wrath” — Just as You are revered and feared, so [too] must one fear and dread Your wrath.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:17:1.hebrew: פגעת את שש ועושה צדק - במי ששמח ועושה צדק, שהן העושים כך, ״בדרכיך יזכירוך״ — אתה פוגע בו אם חוטא כלום, כמו ״ויפגע בו וימת״. קרא הכי הוא: ״פגעת את שש ועושה צדק״ — והן העושין כך; ״בדרכיך יזכירוך״ — באותם דרכים שאתה מייסרן ביסורין יזכירוך לטובה, ואומרים: ״הן אתה קצפת״ בשביל שחטאנו; ״בהם עולם ונושע״ — בשבילם נושע לעולם הבא:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:17:1.english: “You strike him who rejoices and does righteousness” - In [the case of] one who rejoices and does righteousness — who are those who act thus, [so that] “in Your ways they remember You” — You strike him if he sins at all, as in: “And he struck him down and he died” (I Kings 2:25). The verse is [understood] thus: “You strike him who rejoices and does righteousness” — and they are those who act thus; “in Your ways they remember You” — in those ways that You afflict them with suffering, they remember You for good, and they say: “Behold, You were wroth” because we sinned; “upon them of old, that we might be saved” — on account of them, we are saved for the World to Come.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:18:1.hebrew: שחובלת - כמו חבלי יולדה, אף השמים עושין כן, וקשה לעולם, ועל חטא הוא:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:18:1.english: Who experiences labor pains - Like the pangs of a woman in labor; the heavens, too, do so, and it is hard for the world, and it is on account of sin.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:1:1.hebrew: שלמודו קשה עליו כברזל - שקשה לו מרוב קושיות, בשביל משנתו שאינה סדורה לו ואינו זוכר מה כתיב בה, ולפיכך אינו יודע לפרק. אי נמי, שגורסה בטעות: פוטר על החיוב ומחייב על הפטור, ומקשי עלה מדוכתא אחריתי. והכי משמע קרא: ״והוא לא״ — שאינו יודע שמועתו, מפני ש״פנים קלקל״ — שקלקל במשנה, שהיא קודם לגמרא:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:1:1.english: Whose study is hard for him like iron - That it is difficult for him due to an abundance of difficulties, because his Mishnah is not organized for him and he does not remember what is written in it, and therefore he does not know how to resolve them. Alternatively, that he recites it erroneously: ruling exempt for that which is liable and liable for that which is exempt, and raises an objection against it from another place. And this is what the verse means: “And he does not” — that he does not know his tradition, because “he corrupted the face” — that he corrupted the Mishnah, which comes before the Gemara:

Rashi on Taanit 8a:2:1.hebrew: ירבה בישיבה - שיסדירו בני הישיבה משנתם, שנאמר: ״וחיילים״ — בין תלמידים, שהן חיילות חיילות:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:2:1.english: He must increase his time in the academy - That the members of the academy organize their study together, as it is stated: “And armies” — among students, who are grouped into companies and companies:

Rashi on Taanit 8a:2:2.english: And the advantage of skill - When he arranged his study from the beginning.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:3:1.hebrew: כנגד מ' יום שניתנה התורה - שתתקיים בידו, והדר עייל קמיה דר' יוחנן למיגמר גמרא:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:3:1.english: Corresponding to forty days in which the Torah was given - So that it would endure in his hand, and then he would go before Rabbi Yoḥanan to learn the Gemara.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:3:2.hebrew: כנגד תנ"ך - שהן כ"ד ספרים:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:3:2.english: Corresponding to Tanakh - For they are twenty-four books.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:4:1.hebrew: שפנים קלקל - שהראה לו פנים רעות:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:4:1.english: That he corrupted the countenance - For he showed him an unfriendly countenance.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:5:1.hebrew: ירבה עליו רעים - לפייס הימנו, שיסבור לו פנים:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:5:1.english: He must increase friends for him - To seek appeasement from him, so that he will show him a friendly countenance.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:6:1.hebrew: משתכין עליו כנחושת - מאדימין פנים כעין רודיליי"א, כדאמרי' בבבא מציעא (דף כו.): ״דשתיך טפי״ — שהעלה חלודה; שנעצרין (מלהוליד) טל ומטר:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:6:1.english: Corrode upon it like copper - [The heavens] turn reddish in appearance, like rust [rodille], as we say in Bava Metzia (26a): “It has corroded more” — [meaning] that it developed rust; [and here it means] that they are withheld (from bringing forth) dew and rain.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:6:2.hebrew: לוחשי לחישות - בשביל שאין מתפללים תפלה בלחש:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:6:2.english: Those who whisper quiet prayers - Because they do not recite the prayer in a whisper:

Rashi on Taanit 8a:7:1.hebrew: יגיד עליו רעו - יתפלל עליו חבירו, וגבי גשמים כתיב באיוב:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:7:1.english: His fellow tells concerning him - His fellow shall pray for him; and it is written in Job in connection with rain.

Rashi on Taanit 8a:7:2.hebrew: ואין יתרון לבעל הלשון - כלומר, מה הנאה יש לבעל הלשון שיודע ללחוש ואינו לוחש:
Rashi on Taanit 8a:7:2.english: And there is no advantage to the master of the tongue - That is to say, what benefit is there to the master of the tongue, who knows how to whisper and does not whisper?

Tosafot on Taanit 8a:15:1.hebrew: בחולדה ובור כך בהקב"ה על אחת כמה וכמה - פי': "מאמין בחולדה ובור" — מעשה היה בנערה אחת, היתה רוצה לילך לבית אביה, והיה בור בדרך ונפלה. ובא בחור אחד ואמר: "אם אני אעליך, תנשאי לי?" אמרה לו: "הן". ונשבעו ביניהן שהוא לא ישא אשה אחרת, והיא לא תנשא לאיש אחר. ואמרו: "מי מעיד בינינו?" והיתה חולדה אחת הולכת לפני הבור, ואמרו: "אלו שנים, בור וחולדה, יהיו עדים בינינו". והלכו לדרכם. והיא עמדה בשבועתה, והוא נשה אשה אחרת וילדה בן. באת חולדה ונשכתו, ומת. וילדה לו בן שני, ונפל לבור ומת. אמרה לו אשתו: "מה זה המעשה שהגיע לנו שלא כשאר בני אדם?" נזכר השבועה, וסיפר לאשתו כל המעשה. אמרה לו: "א"כ, חזור וקחנה". וכתב לה גט, והלך ונשא את הבתולה. והיינו דאמרי: "המאמין בבור וחולדה" — שהעמידו עדותן:
Tosafot on Taanit 8a:15:1.english: "[One who believes] in the marten and the pit, so [it is; one who believes] in the Holy One, Blessed be He, all the more so" - Explanation: "One who believes in the marten and the pit" — there was an incident involving a certain young woman who wanted to go to her father's house, and there was a pit along the way, and she fell in. A certain young man came along and said, "If I pull you out, will you marry me?" She said to him, "Yes." And they swore to one another that he would not marry another woman, and she would not marry another man. And they said, "Who will bear witness between us?" And there was a marten passing in front of the pit, so they said, "These two, the pit and the marten, shall be witnesses between us." And they went on their way. And she stood by her oath, but he married another woman, and she bore a son. A marten came and bit him, and he died. And she bore him a second son, and he fell into a pit and died. His wife said to him, "What is this occurrence that has befallen us, unlike [what happens to] other people?" He remembered the oath and told his wife the whole story. She said to him, "If so, return and marry her." And he wrote her a bill of divorce, and went and married the maiden. And this is what [the Gemara] means by saying, "one who believes in the pit and the marten" — that they upheld their testimony.

Tosafot on Taanit 8a:6:1.hebrew: אם ראית דור שהשמים משתכין עליו כנחושת מלהוריד גשם עליו וכו' - מכאן מוכיח ר"ת דהא דאמרי' בבבא בתרא (דף יט. ושם): "אין טומנין בסלעים, מ"ט? משום דמשתכי ליה לקדירה" — ר"ל משתכי: מקלקלים המאכל שבקדירה, ובלע"ז אורמשי"ר. והא דאמר "לקדירה" — לאו דוקא לקדירה, אלא למאכל שבקדירה; דהכי נמי קאמר (שבת דף יח:): "האי קדרה חייתא שרי". ואין לפרש כפרש"י, שפי' התם: משתכי — משברים הקדירה; דא"כ, מאי קאמר הכא: "שהשמים משתכין"? ר"ל שהשמים משתברין?! אלא ודאי משתכים — ר"ל מעלין חלודה, כמו דבר שבטל ממלאכתו ימים רבים ומחליד, ובלע"ז ראוליי"ר:
Tosafot on Taanit 8a:6:1.english: "If you see a generation for whom the heavens corrode over them like copper, from bringing down rain upon them, etc." - From here Rabbeinu Tam proves that which we say in Bava Batra (19a and there): "One may not insulate [food] in rocks. What is the reason? Because they ruin the pot" — mishtakhei means to say: they spoil the food that is in the pot, and in Old French, ormesir [to spoil]. And that which it says, "for the pot," is not specifically [referring] to the pot [itself], but rather to the food in the pot; for so it also says (Shabbat 18b): "This raw pot is permitted." And one should not explain according to Rashi, who explained there [that] mishtakhei [means] they break the pot; for if so, what is the meaning of what it says here: "that the heavens mishtakhin"? Does it mean to say that the heavens break?! Rather, certainly, mishtakhim means to say [that] they develop rust, like an object that has been idle from its work for many days and rusts, and in Old French, roillier [to rust].

Tosafot on Taanit 8a:9:1.hebrew: ואי לוחש ועלתה בידו ומגיס דעתו מביא אף לעולם שנאמר יגיד עליו ריעו וגו' - כלומר: אם "יגיד עליו ריעו" — שעל ידו באו הגשמים, והוא מגיס דעתו — "מקנה אף עולה", כלומר: הוא קונה אף; "ועולה" — כלומר: אם עולה, שמגיס דעתו, עליו הוא מקנה האף:
Tosafot on Taanit 8a:9:1.english: "And if he whispers and is successful, and becomes haughty, he brings anger into the world, as it is stated: 'His fellow tells of him, etc.'" - That is to say: If "his fellow tells of him" — that the rain came through him — and he becomes haughty, [then] "acquires anger, exalts" — that is to say, he acquires anger; and "exalts" — that is to say, if he exalts [himself], in that he becomes haughty, upon him he brings anger.
